book.name: Gutut
book.title: Gutut Iesu watu enamot mega nagire guturewa

content: Pol pa sewa Epesas tauen
Apan Apolos pa Korin gapan wande en. Ap wamewa gapan, Pol pa Epesas tauen. Ap mepe Iesu wadiamot mega nagirewa upi yomu tani ame yawamo,
amba singui wayawamon, “Wam ame e anu tumat tayana ame e Guewa Pose Woup Seniwa warayan go uon?” Mu gare anega wane, “Ae uon, nu Guewa Woup Seniwa da ya anuton.”
Menan Pol singui sia wayawamon, “E guegue ambe gapan dup iayaen?” Mu gare wane, “Apan Dion waenapan dup iamoni guegue mega gapan dup ianen.”
Pol sia wadiamon, “Dion dup guegue mega ame koewa anu ae ve sia entanapen dupewa. Me waenapan anega wadiamon, ‘Ewanap tauepi apanewa inap anu tumasen, ame Iesu di.’”
Mame wani, mu Ayop Iesu yaua gapan dup iamon.
Dup iamone amba Pol naniwa iamup seni gapan Guewa Woup Seniwa mu potamup tauen, amba merimu tobayanen ian ugupe noa wan, amba God no oise den waiwanumun.
Apan anu tumat dupewa iamoni ame apan aonagaet pusinawan dere.

Pol Diu nagirewa opata waine paewa aeni siragam yampo gwanap pura gapan gapan, epara ta, nop kaimakaet wadidiamon. God toemu mega amunua oisewa nop tavewa mu anupen menan Pol waenapan den nop gare gare waiwanumun.

Go upi epara tan ya anu tumaset waiwanumun. Mu aroga Iesu anu tumat neginewa inap wawa koko ta wane. Ap menan Pol mu ae vemo, wadiamot nagirewa tambu aen. Mu wam ame use aeniwa iam iam paewa yaua Tiranas gapan pot pot waenapan den anu tumat nopewa ame seyao wareyao taiwanumun.
Mame taiwanumune aeni en dere uon tan. Ame wamewa gapan at Eisia arige wanumuine nagirewa, Diu ge Diu uoni ian ugupe nagirewa iravi Iesu oisewa anune.
Apan Sikiva otu wai gutut mugawa
God Pol gamup kiman yo paua baware ugup ugup taiwandini.
Menan Pol wanup megawa da paniwandiniwa den atup megawa ame waenapan ap me tambun vek nagire inamup amone. Wanup ap gapan inak mutan airampu potamup wanumone tau amon.

Diu apan upi, at da da tau ge tau amon, amba airampu waenapan potamupewa wa oimopen taiwanumune. Diu pirisi ayop mugawa yaua Sikiva otu waiwa nani yamu dere mu ap den taiwanumun. Mu iravi Ayop Iesu yaua aroewa gapan airampu wa oimot wan taiwanumune, anega dian, “Apan Pol opata Iesu yaua waini aroewa gapan airampu ge tau ak!” ap anega wan taiwanumune. Wam da Sikiva otu wai apan da potap airampu wandeni inap ap anega diane.
Go airampu gare diamon, “Ne Iesu asik tan amba Pol den asik tan, go e da?”
Airampu ap wani, apan airampu potape wandeni ame yone set wa aigamup wandeni gure baime ene apan apan tan. Wanup muga benak ae sen, epimu aroga siget munen, amba mu pa garip serarat tau amon.
Diu amba ian ugupe nagirewa den, oit ame anune menan tap baware anun. Menan mu Iesu viriwa aigap di tane.
Menan Iesu anu tumasine nagirewa, kayao banao koewa muga vetavet aroga tan.
Nuat taine amba banao nagirewa aruga buka muga iravi tam tauane, waenapan yamamup omaya iramon. Buka iravi iramone garewa muga moni 50,000 mini.
Negin manegawa gapan Ayop nop megawa senare tau aen amba Iesu dugup mega nagirewa anu tumat muga kai wariwandin.

Wan dim dim ma iragi venaseni ewap, Pol imua upe se pa Ierusalem aet anuni menan at Masedonia ge at Guris tau ge tau aeni, amba pa Ierusalem tauat anun. Pol manega wan, “Pa Ierusalem tauapena amba den ange pa Rom yawat anuivin.”
Ap anuni menan ago mega dere Timoti ge Erastas at Masedonia watu enamon go me wam upine den at Eisia gapan wanden.
Pa Epesas nagirewa anan tan
Wam ame gapan Ayop Iesu anu tumat inagewa taine menan pa Epesas gapan anan da tuk wan.

Ap gapan, gwat keri mini, go gwayayame dena, gapan nanip kaisini apane da yaua Demitias, at Epesas gapan wandiniwa. Me gwat ame gapan god muga yaua Atemas mup paewa gueguewa otu kamontua arugataet kaitamuiniwa. Ap kaisiwanumune gapan apan Demitias evene wai den garewa baware ap gapan wariwanumune.
Menan god muga kaisine nagirewa apan upi nao muga ap umap taine den Demitias venamu wan tauan. Tauane amba Demitias anega wadiamon, “Tatan gwanin, e asigiap nu kaisitoni garewa baware di warivin.

Go e asigiap, apan Pol me opata gapan anega wadiamuiwan, apan da nanip god nuga gueguewa kaisepiwa ame god da uon, ap opata wani gapan waenapan arugataet at Epesas gapan amba at Eisia paua gapan uruga oit ame anu tumasiwanum.

Ap anu tumasepi menan waenapan guewa kaisitoni ya tambupen menan anuin. Amba koewa dawa ame waenapan nu god nuga baware Artemas amba me mup paewa ae antapenain. Nu at Eisia nagire piup iravi den god nuga Atemas aigap wa taragasivin, menan ap tapi ame koerage.”
Nop ame pa nagirewa den anune gapan, mu ugu gangan mutane amba mu ve erewa anega wan, “Nu pa Epesas nagirewa god nuga baware Atemas.”

Ap anega wane menan pa iragi arara babara wa taiwanumun. Amba Epesas nagirewa Gaias ge Aristakas tambumone, mu Pol at Masedonia gapan tanam onamone apane waiwa. Pa nagirewa mu ai okonagen amba iam iam taine paewa gwanap toga uaren ta tauan.
Pol anut mega to iam ame gapan wadidiamopen waenapan imumu wap bigarepen menan aet anun. Go Iesu dugup mega nagirewa me ya aepen menan watanane.
Amba at ame kansoro nagirewa upi, mu Pol evene wai, nop watu enan mup anega wane, “Enda, iam iam taine paewa ya age iwa mu togepi tawa.”
Iam iam paewa gapan waenapan iravi anu waramasene iwa upi itap wa atap wa taiwanumun. Waenapan aruga iam iam ame gapan tauane, iwa mu oare.

Diu nagirewa apan muga da yaua Aleksanda iam iam nagirewa namumup baraene, ap menan anu waramasene nagirewa anega anune, arara babara ibariwa apan ma me di. Aleksanda yone waenapan nop ae vep me gare wadiamopen menan naniwa wadaven.

Go wam ame iam iam nagirewa me ire yawane me Diu apanewa, menan mu iragi senao wa ge wa tan anega wan, “Nu pa nuga Epesas, god nuga Artemas me aigap iragen!” Ap anega senao waiwanumune amba wam airase dere uon tan.

Senao waiwanumune pa sewa kwayup ok sini apanewa baigan tapen men watanamo amba anega diamon, “Pa Epesas waenapan negawa, wapena anun. Waenapan iravi asik tane nu pa Epesas nagire god nuga baware Atemas mup paewa kwayup taitoni nagirewa. Gwat kimani viseni viriwa kwayupe den taivin.
Apan da nop ame ya waboboreta menan nop ae vean bumbawam da ya tane.
E apan dere mam naumo onayan go mu god nuga mup paewa gwanap puraput da up ya tan, god nuga yaua da ya wa koeamen.
Demitias evene wai den apan da enu yave wat anupiwa ame wanene paewa watapane bawarewa nagirewa gwanap wanumam menan mugenat wat tamanamain.
Go nop da aigap sia wat anunewa, waenapan iragi ap mepe iamet amba nop ame sia wait.
Menan ma dimen taiwanin? Ibariwa nu oare. Bawarewa nugawa nu anan tat anu enu yawan wapi, nu gare anenen wait?”
Ap anega wani iam iam tobore boge pa wa oimon.
